Design: Track lesion IDs only where evidence supports correspondence across visits
Acceptance: Uncertain lesion match abstains

SIM.06 — Toxicity/event grading
Design: Record abnormal observations and assign CTCAE grade only with defined evidence
Acceptance: Without required evidence no formal grade
  READ A13 NCI CTCAE version 6.0 — Adverse-event definitions, laboratory abnormalities and grading criteria — https://dctd.cancer.gov/research/ctep-trials/for-sites/adverse-events/ctcae-v6.pdf
  READ A12 NCI Breast Cancer Treatment PDQ — Stage-specific treatment, receptor status and neoadjuvant therapy sections — https://www.cancer.gov/types/breast/hp/breast-treatment-pdq

  Avoid: Do not infer anatomical truth from smoothing
